# adds_computer (Data Source)

Reads an existing Active Directory computer account. Use it to reference machines that are not managed by this Terraform configuration, for example when adding their accounts to a gMSA's `principals_allowed_to_retrieve_managed_password`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing computer account that Terraform does not manage, for example a
# server that was domain-joined by another process.
data "adds_computer" "app_server" {
  identity = "APP01$"
}

# Reference the looked-up account where a security principal is expected, such as the
# hosts allowed to retrieve a gMSA's managed password.
resource "adds_gmsa" "app_svc" {
  name          = "app-svc-gmsa"
  dns_host_name = "app-svc.contoso.local"
  path          = "Managed Service Accounts"

  principals_allowed_to_retrieve_managed_password = [
    data.adds_computer.app_server.sid,
  ]
}

output "app_server" {
  value = {
    distinguished_name = data.adds_computer.app_server.distinguished_name
    sid                = data.adds_computer.app_server.sid
    operating_system   = data.adds_computer.app_server.operating_system
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the computer to look up. Accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name` or `sAMAccountName` (with or without the trailing `$`). Reading fails if no account matches.

### Read-Only

- `account_not_delegated` (Boolean) Whether the account is marked sensitive and cannot be delegated.
- `compound_identity_supported` (Boolean) Whether the account advertises Kerberos armoring / compound identity support.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name (`displayName`).
- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the account.
- `dns_host_name` (String) Fully qualified DNS host name of the machine.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.
- `id` (String) Account `objectGUID`, stable across renames and moves.
- `kerberos_encryption_type` (Set of String) Kerberos encryption types the account supports. Any of `None`, `DES`, `RC4`, `AES128`, `AES256`.
- `location` (String) Physical location of the machine (`location`).
- `managed_by` (String) Distinguished name of the account's owner (`managedBy`).
- `name` (String) Computer name (the `CN`).
- `operating_system` (String) Operating system reported by the joined machine (`operatingSystem`).
- `operating_system_version` (String) Operating system version reported by the joined machine (`operatingSystemVersion`).
- `path` (String) Slash-delimited path of the container holding the account, relative to the domain root.
- `protected_from_accidental_deletion` (Boolean) Whether the account carries Deny access control entries protecting it from accidental deletion.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Pre-Windows 2000 logon name, including the trailing `$`.
- `service_principal_names` (Set of String) Service principal names registered on the account.
- `sid` (String) Security identifier of the account.
- `trusted_for_delegation` (Boolean) Whether the account is trusted for unconstrained Kerberos delegation.
- `user_principal_name` (String) User principal name of the account.
